# Mumble

> Mumble is voice dictation for Mac, Windows, and Linux. Hold a shortcut, speak, and Mumble transcribes the audio with Claude or Codex — through the sign-in their apps already hold — and pastes the text wherever the cursor is.

- Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later): https://anoma.ly/mumble/files/releases/Mumble-latest-arm64.dmg, or `brew install --cask anomalyco/tap/mumble`
- Windows 10 or 11 beta, x64 and ARM64: per-user Setup.exe installers at __ORIGIN__/
- Linux beta, x86_64 Arch with glibc 2.44 or later: `curl -fsSL https://anoma.ly/mumble/files/install-linux.sh | sh`

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/khoi/mumble/blob/dev/README.md): features, settings, privacy, and troubleshooting
- [Windows guide](https://github.com/khoi/mumble/blob/dev/docs/windows.md)
- [Linux guide](https://github.com/khoi/mumble/blob/dev/docs/linux.md)
- [Transforms](https://anoma.ly/mumble/docs/transforms): the JavaScript API for changing dictated text before Mumble pastes it, including `fetch` and `node:child_process`
- [Managing Mumble](https://anoma.ly/mumble/docs/admin): macOS configuration-profile keys that turn off OpenCode processing, transforms, Labs, and updates, or hold transforms to this computer
